transcript.text: You mentioned that you managed a team of 12 at a fulfilment centre handling 8,000 orders a day. Can you describe your leadership approach in that role?

I worked for seven years in e-commerce logistics in Pune, finishing as operations lead managing a team of 12 at a fulfilment centre that handled 8,000 orders a day. I brought the order-to-dispatch time down from 26 hours to 19. Then I took a two-year break from work, and I completed a supply-chain analytics course in 2024 to keep learning. I'm applying now to return at a higher level, because I want to design the supply network and not only run one site.
You mentioned managing a team of 12 at a fulfilment centre handling 8,000 orders a day. What were the biggest challenges you faced while leading this team and how did you overcome them?
transcript.anchor_quote: managing a team of 12 at a fulfilment centre that handled 8,000 orders a day

transcript.text: To cut the dispatch time I changed the pick-path in the warehouse. Fast-moving items were moved closer to the packing area. Packers were also asked to start the day with the oldest orders. That solved most of the delay in the afternoon batch.
How did you measure the success of your leadership and the improvements your team made during that period?
transcript.anchor_quote: To cut the dispatch time I changed the pick-path in the warehouse. Fast-moving items were moved closer to the packing area. Packers were also asked to start the day with the oldest orders

transcript.text: I don't know what the company's current dispatch time is. I left two years ago and I haven't been in contact with the team since.
You mentioned you want to design the supply network rather than run a single site. What motivated this shift in your career focus?
The break helped me reflect and recharge. I have emerged with a fresh perspective and I am more motivated than ever to create impact in the next phase of my journey.

transcript.text: Looking ahead, my plan is to join a supply-chain strategy team. My thesis is that smaller warehouses closer to customers would lower delivery times in a city like Pune, and I want to learn the costing to test that.

feedback.summary: The candidate has clear motivation to transition into supply-chain strategy and has maintained engagement by completing a relevant course during a career break. However, there was some initial confusion or overstatement about leadership experience, which was clarified later to be an individual contributor role. Answers sometimes lacked specific measurable outcomes or detail about personal ownership and impact in previous roles. The candidate also preferred not to address hypothetical or forward-looking innovations directly, instead emphasizing current capabilities. Sharing concrete examples of analyses performed and their impact would strengthen the profile. Overall, there is good motivation and some applicable experience areas to develop further.
